chunks: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام:

key_terms.ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: Ibn Abi 'Umayr, a major transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيِّ: al-Halabi, the narrator transmitting from the Imam
key_terms.عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, a narrator in the sanad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: Meaning: the same as the preceding hadith in wording or meaning

ai.seo_question: What does "مِثْلَهُ" mean in a hadith transmission in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This report consists of a narrator chain followed by a brief reference indicating that the wording or ruling is the same as the previous hadith. It functions as a supporting transmission for the same legal content in the chapter on rulings concerning a person killed in a crush and related cases of unidentified killers and blood-money liability.
